HARKESH MANUJA J. (Oral)
1. Dispute in the present case is only with respect to grant of 100% solatium along with interest as per provisions of Section 30 and 1st Schedule of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the acquisition of land owned by the petitioners in terms of provisions of National Highways Act, 1956.

sentences.text: 2. The contention raised on behalf of the petitioners is that though the award was passed by CALA on 21.09.2015, yet, no solatium was paid whereas, in terms of settled law, the petitioners-landowners were entitled for 100% solatium.

Mr. Mahinder Joshi, Advocate for Mr. R.S. Madan, Advocate, appears and accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.2-NHAI, whereas, 1 of 2 CWP-3539-2026 (O&M) --2-- Mr. Karunesh Kaushal, AAG, Punjab, accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.3.
